def check_replay_rates_cpu(reward):
    f=lambda x:torch.tensor(x,dtype=torch.float32)
    yes=torch.ones(1,dtype=torch.bool);no=~yes;zero=f([0.]);one=f([.8]);front=f([[.35,.35]]);high=f([[.27,.27]])
    def rate(vx=one,request=yes,airborne=no,bottom=high,fore=front):
        return reward.requested_forward_rate(request=request,attempt=yes,landed=no,vx=vx,vy=zero,roll=zero,pitch=zero,airborne=airborne,wheel_bottom=bottom,wheel_front=fore,origin_x=zero)
    vals=dict(forward_clear=float(rate()),forward_low=float(rate(bottom=f([[0.,0.]]))),reverse_clear=float(rate(vx=-one)),stationary_high=float(rate(vx=zero)),only_one_wheel_clear=float(rate(bottom=f([[.27,0.]]))),far_jump=float(rate(fore=f([[-.10,-.10]]))),no_request_on_ground=float(rate(request=no)),measured_flight_after_request=float(rate(request=no,airborne=yes)))
    assert vals==dict(forward_clear=3.,forward_low=1.,reverse_clear=-3.,stationary_high=0.,only_one_wheel_clear=1.,far_jump=1.,no_request_on_ground=0.,measured_flight_after_request=3.)
    gate=lambda front,vx:float(reward.forward_takeoff_factor(wheel_front=f([[front,front]]),origin_x=zero,vx=f([vx])))
    gates=dict(far_vertical=gate(-.10,.8),near_vertical=gate(.15,0.),near_reverse=gate(.15,-.8),near_forward=gate(.15,.8))
    assert gates==dict(far_vertical=0.,near_vertical=0.,near_reverse=0.,near_forward=1.)
    x=torch.linspace(-1.,1.,20000);b=torch.stack((x.clamp(0,.3),(-x).clamp(0,.3)),-1)
    out=reward.requested_forward_rate(request=torch.ones(20000,dtype=torch.bool),attempt=torch.ones(20000,dtype=torch.bool),landed=torch.zeros(20000,dtype=torch.bool),vx=x,vy=x*.1,roll=x*.1,pitch=x*.1,airborne=torch.zeros(20000,dtype=torch.bool),wheel_bottom=b,wheel_front=torch.stack((x,x),-1),origin_x=torch.zeros_like(x))
    assert out.shape==(20000,) and out.dtype==torch.float32 and torch.isfinite(out).all() and out.abs().max()<=3
    return dict(passed=True,cases=vals,takeoff_gate=gates,vectorized_float32_environments=20000,no_new_success_or_health_threshold=True,synthetic_not_learning_or_skill_proof=True)

"""Reward-only shaping for the human-authorized 270mm step task.

No action, command, physics, termination, success contract, RNG or optimizer
writes. The new cost reads only the already delayed leg target. Callback transport uses measured collider motion, not a ballistic
prediction or a root/COM proxy for wheel clearance. Constants are reward scales,
not new qualification, health or success thresholds.
"""
import torch

RECIPE = dict(version='step270_airborne_feasible_target_v5',
    approach_event_scale=4., clearance_transport_event_scale=8.,
    forward_takeoff_event_scale=.25, actual_edge_event_scale=6.,
    actual_landing_event_scale=8., actual_stable_recovery_event_scale=16.,
    requested_forward_rate_weight=3., air_zero_torque_weight=.5,
    leg_tuck_weight=1.7, wheel_below_base_weight=.5,
    airborne_leg_target_overdrive_weight=-.05,
    clearance_target_m=.270, existing_forward_command_m_s=.8,
    path_start_x_m=-.10, path_target_x_m=.60,
    strict_goal_and_command_publisher_unchanged=True,
    signed_reverse_rate=True, measured_clearance_carry_gain=2.,
    clearance_carry_start_front_x_m=0., clearance_carry_full_front_x_m=.35,
    takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m=-.05, takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m=.15,
    keep_forward_reward_during_measured_flight_after_request=True)


def path_increment(*, previous_front, current_front, wheel_bottom, origin_x,
                   active, airborne, launched, clean_upright, vx,
                   takeoff, edge_event, landing, recovery, previous_joint_potential=None):
    """Control-independent callback contribution; no positive-only delta.

    Signed, bounded potential differences prevent repeated back/forth farming.
    The joint potential is zero when the wheels are still far from the step;
    holding a high vertical jump stationary earns zero potential increment.
    Vertical progress far from the edge no longer receives the old event reward. Actual edge,
    landing and stable-recovery events retain their strict original witnesses.
    """
    start=RECIPE['path_start_x_m']; end=RECIPE['path_target_x_m']
    previous=previous_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    current=current_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    initialized=(previous_front > -1.e5).all(-1)
    delta=((current.clamp(start,end)-previous.clamp(start,end))/(end-start))
    gate=active & clean_upright & initialized
    approach=gate.to(vx.dtype)*delta*RECIPE['approach_event_scale']
    clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
    joint=((current-.10)/.25).clamp(0.,1.)*clearance.square()
    old_joint=joint if previous_joint_potential is None else previous_joint_potential
    transport=gate.to(vx.dtype)*(joint-old_joint)*RECIPE['clearance_transport_event_scale']
    takeoff_value=takeoff.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)*RECIPE['forward_takeoff_event_scale']
    events=(takeoff_value+edge_event.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_edge_event_scale']
            +landing.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_landing_event_scale']
            +recovery.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_stable_recovery_event_scale'])
    return dict(approach=approach,clearance_transport=transport,strict_events=events,
                total=approach+transport+events,next_joint_potential=joint)


def requested_forward_rate(*, request, attempt, landed, vx, vy, roll, pitch,
                           airborne=None, wheel_bottom=None, wheel_front=None,
                           origin_x=None):
    # Measured wheel clearance and forward motion must coincide. No command,
    # force, action, success flag or physics state is written here.
    airborne=torch.zeros_like(request) if airborne is None else airborne
    active=(request | airborne) & attempt & ~landed
    alignment=torch.exp(-(vy/.3).square()-(roll/.3).square()-(pitch/.3).square())
    quality=torch.ones_like(vx)
    if wheel_bottom is not None and wheel_front is not None and origin_x is not None:
        front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
        near=((front-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m']) /
              (RECIPE['clearance_carry_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
        clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
        quality=quality+RECIPE['measured_clearance_carry_gain']*near*clearance.square()
    return active.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(-1.,1.)*alignment*quality


def forward_takeoff_factor(*, wheel_front, origin_x, vx):
    front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    near=((front-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m']) /
          (RECIPE['takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
    return near*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)


def forward_takeoff_rate(env,original_func,original_params):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    value=original_func(env,**original_params)
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
    return value*forward_takeoff_factor(wheel_front=env.h1_phase.previous_front,
        origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0],vx=root[:,7])


def measured_rate(env,name):
    p=env.h1_phase
    if name=='path_progress':return p.progress_control/float(env.step_dt)
    if name=='requested_forward':
        from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
        root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
        x,y,z,w=root[:,3:7].unbind(-1)
        roll=torch.atan2(2*(w*x+y*z),1-2*(x*x+y*y))
        pitch=torch.asin((2*(w*y-z*x)).clamp(-1.,1.))
        return requested_forward_rate(request=p.request_for_action,attempt=p.attempt,
            landed=p.landed,vx=root[:,7],vy=root[:,8],roll=roll,pitch=pitch,
            airborne=p.air_ticks>0,wheel_front=p.previous_front,
            wheel_bottom=p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2] if 'step_wheel_min' in p.last_measured else None,
            origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0])
    raise ValueError(name)


def airborne_tuck_rate(env):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    p=env.h1_phase;r=env.scene['robot'];data=r.data
    root=tensor(data.root_state_w)
    ids=[r.body_names.index(x) for x in ('left_wheel','right_wheel')]
    delta=tensor(data.body_pos_w)[:,ids]-root[:,None,:3]
    current_clear=(p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2]>.005).all(-1)
    active=p.attempt & (p.air_ticks>0) & current_clear & ~p.landed & ~p.crossed.all(-1)
    # Same original SCUT/Fudan measured body-to-wheel length formula.
    # Request expiry must not end retraction shaping during measured flight.
    # Stop before landing extension once both wheels actually crossed.
    compact=torch.exp(-torch.sum(torch.abs(delta.norm(dim=-1)-.22),dim=1)*4.)
    return active.to(root.dtype)*compact



def infeasible_leg_target_cost(*, raw_actions, scale, offset, lower, upper, diff_min, diff_max):
    # A reward reference only. Never replace or edit the applied action.
    # The measured delayed action term retains the original scale/default offset.
    target=raw_actions*scale+offset
    feasible=torch.maximum(torch.minimum(target,upper),lower)
    cranks=[]
    for crank,hip in ((0,1),(2,3)):
        lo=torch.maximum(lower[crank],feasible[:,hip]+diff_min)
        hi=torch.minimum(upper[crank],feasible[:,hip]+diff_max)
        cranks.append(torch.maximum(torch.minimum(feasible[:,crank],hi),lo))
    feasible=torch.stack((cranks[0],feasible[:,1],cranks[1],feasible[:,3]),dim=-1)
    return ((target-feasible)/scale).square().mean(-1)


def airborne_leg_target_overdrive_rate(env):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    from mod4_task import CONTRACT, LEG_ORDER
    p=env.h1_phase
    term=env.action_manager.get_term('legs')
    if tuple(term._joint_names)!=tuple(LEG_ORDER):
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected leg action order')
    raw=tensor(term.raw_actions)
    lower=raw.new_tensor([CONTRACT['joints'][n]['limits_si'][0] for n in LEG_ORDER])
    upper=raw.new_tensor([CONTRACT['joints'][n]['limits_si'][1] for n in LEG_ORDER])
    # raw_actions is AFTER the original delay line; _offset is the actual
    # default pose captured by the installed SDK JointPositionAction.
    cost=infeasible_leg_target_cost(raw_actions=raw,scale=term._scale,offset=term._offset,
        lower=lower,upper=upper,diff_min=term.diff_min,diff_max=term.diff_max)
    current_clear=(p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2]>.005).all(-1)
    active=p.attempt & (p.air_ticks>0) & current_clear & ~p.landed & ~p.crossed.all(-1)
    return active.to(raw.dtype)*cost

    The outer send() owns this raw SSH channel through body authentication;
    HTTPConnection.close() only drops its borrowed view. Always close the raw

    def sendall(self,data):return self.channel.sendall(data)
    def makefile(self,*args,**kwargs):return self.channel.makefile(*args,**kwargs)
    def close(self):pass

from pathlib import Path

class LifetimeGoalCounter:
    def __init__(self,initial_counts,initial_crossed):
        self.before={k:np.asarray(initial_counts[k]).copy() for k in EVENTS};self.n=len(self.before[EVENTS[0]])
        assert all(a.shape==(self.n,) and a.dtype.kind in 'iu' and (a>=0).all() for a in self.before.values())
        self.initial_sums={k:int(a.sum()) for k,a in self.before.items()}
        self.before_cross=np.asarray(initial_crossed,dtype=bool).copy();assert self.before_cross.shape==(self.n,2)
        self.total={k:0 for k in EVENTS};self.by_env={k:np.zeros(self.n,dtype=np.uint64) for k in EVENTS}
        self.cross_by_env=np.zeros(self.n,dtype=np.uint64);self.rows=0;self.negative_counter_envframes=0
        self.invalid_rows=0;self.last_error=None;self.write_errors=[]

    def complete(self,row):
        try:
            after={k:np.asarray(row[k]) for k in EVENTS};done=np.asarray(row['done'],dtype=bool);cross=np.asarray(row['step_wheel_crossed'],dtype=bool)
            if done.shape!=(self.n,) or cross.shape!=(self.n,2):raise ValueError('Counter row shape')
            if not all(a.shape==(self.n,) and a.dtype.kind in 'iu' and (a>=0).all() for a in after.values()):raise ValueError('Counter row integer schema')
            deltas={k:a.astype(np.int64)-self.before[k].astype(np.int64) for k,a in after.items()}
        except (KeyError,ValueError,TypeError) as error:
            self.invalid_rows+=1;self.last_error=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error);return False
        for k,delta in deltas.items():
            self.negative_counter_envframes+=int((delta<0).sum());delta=np.maximum(delta,0).astype(np.uint64)
            self.total[k]+=int(delta.sum(dtype=np.uint64));self.by_env[k]+=delta
            self.before[k]=after[k].copy();self.before[k][done]=0
        self.cross_by_env+=(cross.all(-1)&~self.before_cross.all(-1)).astype(np.uint64)
        self.before_cross=cross.copy();self.before_cross[done]=False;self.rows+=1
        return True

    def snapshot(self):
        return {'schema':'completed_control_goal_events_v1','complete_control_rows':self.rows,'num_envs':self.n,
                'environment_control_transitions':self.rows*self.n,'events':dict(self.total),'initial_counter_snapshot_sums':self.initial_sums,
                'unique_env_ids_with_event':{k:int((a>0).sum()) for k,a in self.by_env.items()},
                'both_leading_edges_cross_event_count':int(self.cross_by_env.sum()),'negative_counter_envframes':self.negative_counter_envframes,
                'invalid_rows':self.invalid_rows,'last_error':self.last_error,'diagnostic_valid':self.invalid_rows==0 and self.negative_counter_envframes==0,
                'diagnostic_write_errors':list(self.write_errors),'selected_resets_accounted_from_previous_complete_row_done':True,
                'only_completed_control_rows_not_partial_physics_callbacks':True,
                'cross_event_is_original_leading_edge_truth_not_complete_footprint_landing':True,
                'not_frozen_policy_skill_graduation_or_new_training_gate':True}

    def save(self,folder):
        p=Path(folder)/'CONTROL_LIFETIME_GOAL_EVENTS_ACTUAL.json';tmp=p.with_suffix('.json.partial')
        try:
            tmp.write_text(json.dumps(self.snapshot(),indent=2),encoding='utf8');os.replace(tmp,p);return True
        except OSError as error:
            self.write_errors.append({'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error),'complete_control_rows':self.rows});return False

"""SCUT jump/airborne formulae + Fudan jump shaping, on MOD4 measured state.

SCUTRobotLab portions: Copyright (c) 2026 SCUTRobotLab, SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT.
Reference source snapshots, exact parameter attribution and differential checks
are in this experiment's source index. This module changes reward only.
"""
import torch

PROFILE = dict(
    version='scut_fudan_jump_reward_v1',
    tuck_leg_length_m=.22,
    extend_leg_length_m=.31, leg_exp_l1_gain=4.,
    zero_wheel_torque_sigma=1.5, Fudan_weighted_rate_clip=2.5,
    weights={'push_vz':1., 'flight_vz':6., 'flight':.15,
             'leg_tuck':1.7, 'takeoff_extend':.5,
             'wheel_below_base':2., 'air_wheel_zero_torque':20.,
             'orientation':-25., 'angular_velocity_xy':-.1},
    geometry_adaptation='body-to-wheel 3D lengths from actual MOD4 link poses; tuck .22 SCUT default, extend .31 Fudan target',
    no_assist_force_or_air_reset_or_privileged_actor_observation=True,
    flight_mask='existing H1 air_ticks>0; measured both-wheel clearance, all34 clearance, nonwheel clean and positive-vz history; no new success threshold',
    active_scope='H1 public4 request rows with an actual ready attempt; every normal action row retains its original reward',
)

def terms(*, active, airborne, supported, vz, leg_lengths, wheel_bottom_relative_z,
          wheel_torque, projected_gravity, angular_velocity_body):
    """Unweighted reward rates; caller supplies current measured states only."""
    af=active.float(); ff=(active & airborne).float()
    push=(active & ~airborne & supported)
    # SCUT takeoff_vel_z. Fudan encourage_jump's positive-vz component (.15)
    # is not stacked: this explicit push-only component has MOD4 weight 1.
    result={'push_vz':push.float()*torch.clamp(vz,min=0.),
            'flight_vz':ff*(vz>0).float()*vz,
            'flight':ff,
            # Fudan exp(-4*sum(abs(L0-target))) on MOD4 measured leg lengths.
            'leg_tuck':ff*torch.exp(-torch.sum(torch.abs(leg_lengths-PROFILE['tuck_leg_length_m']),dim=1)*4.),
            'takeoff_extend':(push & (vz>.15)).float()*torch.exp(-torch.sum(torch.abs(leg_lengths-.31),dim=1)*4.),
            # SCUT wheel_height_below_base_exp (target .22, sigma .01).
            'wheel_below_base':ff*torch.exp(-torch.square(wheel_bottom_relative_z+.22)/.01).mean(dim=1),
            # SCUT enabled airborne weight 20 and sigma 1.5.
            'air_wheel_zero_torque':ff*torch.exp(-torch.square(torch.abs(wheel_torque).max(dim=1).values/1.5)),
            # Fudan's actual orientation and body angular speed, not term-name inference.
            'orientation':af*torch.sum(torch.square(projected_gravity[:,:2]),dim=1),
            'angular_velocity_xy':af*torch.sum(torch.square(angular_velocity_body[:,:2]),dim=1)}
    return result

def _tensor(v):
    if hasattr(v,'torch'):return v.torch
    if torch.is_tensor(v):return v
    import warp as wp
    return wp.to_torch(v)

def _current(env):
    p=getattr(env,'h1_phase',None)
    if p is None:return {k:torch.zeros(env.num_envs,device=env.device) for k in PROFILE['weights']}
    # A single callback snapshot is shared by all reward terms in this control.
    cache=getattr(env,'_h1_scut_reward_cache',None);clock=int(env._sim_step_counter)
    if cache is not None and cache[0]==clock:return cache[1]
    r=env.scene['robot'];data=r.data;root=_tensor(data.root_state_w)
    ids=[r.body_names.index(x) for x in ('left_wheel','right_wheel')]
    wheelpos=_tensor(data.body_pos_w)[:,ids];delta=wheelpos-root[:,None,:3]
    wheel_ids=[r.joint_names.index(x) for x in ('left_wheel_spin','right_wheel_spin')]
    # Actual authored collider bottom, evaluated in the inherited physical callback.
    wc=env._h1_scut_last_wheel_clearance
    forces=env._integrated_contact.history[:,0].norm(dim=-1)
    airborne=p.air_ticks>0  # existing callback truth: both wheels clear, all34 clear, nonwheel clean, prior positive vz
    active=p.attempt & p.request_for_action
    # Exact original request/attempt/strict event truth and physical dynamics are untouched.
    rel_bottom=wc-root[:,2,None]
    v=terms(active=active,airborne=airborne,supported=(forces>1.).any(-1),
        vz=root[:,9],leg_lengths=delta.norm(dim=-1),wheel_bottom_relative_z=rel_bottom,
        wheel_torque=_tensor(data.applied_torque)[:,wheel_ids],
        projected_gravity=_tensor(data.projected_gravity_b),
        angular_velocity_body=_tensor(data.root_ang_vel_b))
    env._h1_scut_reward_cache=(clock,v)
    env._h1_scut_reward_last=dict(active=active,airborne=airborne,terms=v)
    return v

FUDAN_TERMS=('flight_vz','flight','leg_tuck','takeoff_extend','orientation','angular_velocity_xy')
def measured_reward(env,name):
    raw=_current(env)[name]
    if name in FUDAN_TERMS:
        weight=PROFILE['weights'][name]
        return (raw*weight).clamp(-2.5,2.5)/weight
    return raw

def mask_replaced_jump_cost(env,original_func,original_params):
    value=original_func(env,**original_params);p=getattr(env,'h1_phase',None)
    if p is None:return value
    active=p.attempt & p.request_for_action
    return torch.where(active,torch.zeros_like(value),value)

def configure(cfg):
    from isaaclab.managers import RewardTermCfg
    from h1_takeoff_progress_reward_v2 import configure as original
    original(cfg)
    # Replace the old orientation/legacy-rate costs only on this jump attempt.
    # Normal rows retain the exact original function, params, weight and value.
    replaced=[]
    for name in ('flat_orientation_y','flat_orientation_y_v','flat_orientation_x_v','ang_vel_xy'):
        t=getattr(cfg.rewards,name,None)
        if t is not None:
            replaced.append(dict(name=name,weight=t.weight,func=t.func.__module__+'.'+t.func.__qualname__))
            t.params=dict(original_func=t.func,original_params=dict(t.params));t.func=mask_replaced_jump_cost
    for name,weight in PROFILE['weights'].items():
        setattr(cfg.rewards,'h1_scut_fudan_'+name,RewardTermCfg(func=measured_reward,weight=weight,params={'name':name}))
    cfg._h1_scut_fudan_recipe=dict(PROFILE,replaced_original_jump_costs=replaced)
    return cfg

def loaded_recipe(env):
    """Read actual live RewardManager terms without altering a manager or trajectory."""
    rows=[]
    for name,cfg in zip(env.reward_manager._term_names,env.reward_manager._term_cfgs):
        if name.startswith('h1_scut_fudan_') or name in ('flat_orientation_y','flat_orientation_y_v','flat_orientation_x_v','ang_vel_xy'):
            rows.append(dict(name=name,weight=float(cfg.weight),func=cfg.func.__module__+'.'+cfg.func.__qualname__,params=repr(cfg.params)))
    assert {r['name'] for r in rows if r['name'].startswith('h1_scut_fudan_')}=={'h1_scut_fudan_'+k for k in PROFILE['weights']}
    return dict(profile=PROFILE,actual_loaded_terms=rows,no_new_actor_input=True)

"""Reward-only shaping for the human-authorized 270mm step task.

No action, command, physics, termination, success contract, RNG or optimizer
access. Callback transport uses measured collider motion, not a ballistic
prediction or a root/COM proxy for wheel clearance. Constants are reward scales,
not new qualification, health or success thresholds.
"""
import torch

RECIPE = dict(version='step270_forward_clearance_airborne_tuck_v3',
    approach_event_scale=4., clearance_transport_event_scale=8.,
    forward_takeoff_event_scale=.25, actual_edge_event_scale=6.,
    actual_landing_event_scale=8., actual_stable_recovery_event_scale=16.,
    requested_forward_rate_weight=3., air_zero_torque_weight=.5,
    leg_tuck_weight=1.7, wheel_below_base_weight=.5,
    clearance_target_m=.270, existing_forward_command_m_s=.8,
    path_start_x_m=-.10, path_target_x_m=.60,
    strict_goal_and_command_publisher_unchanged=True,
    signed_reverse_rate=True, measured_clearance_carry_gain=2.,
    clearance_carry_start_front_x_m=0., clearance_carry_full_front_x_m=.35,
    takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m=-.05, takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m=.15,
    keep_forward_reward_during_measured_flight_after_request=True)


def path_increment(*, previous_front, current_front, wheel_bottom, origin_x,
                   active, airborne, launched, clean_upright, vx,
                   takeoff, edge_event, landing, recovery, previous_joint_potential=None):
    """Control-independent callback contribution; no positive-only delta.

    Signed, bounded potential differences prevent repeated back/forth farming.
    The joint potential is zero when the wheels are still far from the step;
    holding a high vertical jump stationary earns zero potential increment.
    Vertical progress far from the edge no longer receives the old event reward. Actual edge,
    landing and stable-recovery events retain their strict original witnesses.
    """
    start=RECIPE['path_start_x_m']; end=RECIPE['path_target_x_m']
    previous=previous_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    current=current_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    initialized=(previous_front > -1.e5).all(-1)
    delta=((current.clamp(start,end)-previous.clamp(start,end))/(end-start))
    gate=active & clean_upright & initialized
    approach=gate.to(vx.dtype)*delta*RECIPE['approach_event_scale']
    clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
    joint=((current-.10)/.25).clamp(0.,1.)*clearance.square()
    old_joint=joint if previous_joint_potential is None else previous_joint_potential
    transport=gate.to(vx.dtype)*(joint-old_joint)*RECIPE['clearance_transport_event_scale']
    takeoff_value=takeoff.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)*RECIPE['forward_takeoff_event_scale']
    events=(takeoff_value+edge_event.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_edge_event_scale']
            +landing.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_landing_event_scale']
            +recovery.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_stable_recovery_event_scale'])
    return dict(approach=approach,clearance_transport=transport,strict_events=events,
                total=approach+transport+events,next_joint_potential=joint)


def requested_forward_rate(*, request, attempt, landed, vx, vy, roll, pitch,
                           airborne=None, wheel_bottom=None, wheel_front=None,
                           origin_x=None):
    # Measured wheel clearance and forward motion must coincide. No command,
    # force, action, success flag or physics state is written here.
    airborne=torch.zeros_like(request) if airborne is None else airborne
    active=(request | airborne) & attempt & ~landed
    alignment=torch.exp(-(vy/.3).square()-(roll/.3).square()-(pitch/.3).square())
    quality=torch.ones_like(vx)
    if wheel_bottom is not None and wheel_front is not None and origin_x is not None:
        front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
        near=((front-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m']) /
              (RECIPE['clearance_carry_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
        clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
        quality=quality+RECIPE['measured_clearance_carry_gain']*near*clearance.square()
    return active.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(-1.,1.)*alignment*quality


def forward_takeoff_factor(*, wheel_front, origin_x, vx):
    front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    near=((front-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m']) /
          (RECIPE['takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
    return near*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)


def forward_takeoff_rate(env,original_func,original_params):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    value=original_func(env,**original_params)
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
    return value*forward_takeoff_factor(wheel_front=env.h1_phase.previous_front,
        origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0],vx=root[:,7])


def measured_rate(env,name):
    p=env.h1_phase
    if name=='path_progress':return p.progress_control/float(env.step_dt)
    if name=='requested_forward':
        from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
        root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
        x,y,z,w=root[:,3:7].unbind(-1)
        roll=torch.atan2(2*(w*x+y*z),1-2*(x*x+y*y))
        pitch=torch.asin((2*(w*y-z*x)).clamp(-1.,1.))
        return requested_forward_rate(request=p.request_for_action,attempt=p.attempt,
            landed=p.landed,vx=root[:,7],vy=root[:,8],roll=roll,pitch=pitch,
            airborne=p.air_ticks>0,wheel_front=p.previous_front,
            wheel_bottom=p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2] if 'step_wheel_min' in p.last_measured else None,
            origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0])
    raise ValueError(name)


def airborne_tuck_rate(env):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    p=env.h1_phase;r=env.scene['robot'];data=r.data
    root=tensor(data.root_state_w)
    ids=[r.body_names.index(x) for x in ('left_wheel','right_wheel')]
    delta=tensor(data.body_pos_w)[:,ids]-root[:,None,:3]
    active=p.attempt & (p.air_ticks>0) & ~p.landed & ~p.crossed.all(-1)
    # Same original SCUT/Fudan measured body-to-wheel length formula.
    # Request expiry must not end retraction shaping during measured flight.
    # Stop before landing extension once both wheels actually crossed.
    compact=torch.exp(-torch.sum(torch.abs(delta.norm(dim=-1)-.22),dim=1)*4.)
    return active.to(root.dtype)*compact


def configure(cfg):
    from isaaclab.managers import RewardTermCfg
    # Keep original event/height progress in diagnostics and checkpoint state;
    # replace only its contribution to the scalar learning reward.
    cfg.rewards.h1_control_events.weight=0.
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_air_wheel_zero_torque.weight=RECIPE['air_zero_torque_weight']
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.weight=RECIPE['leg_tuck_weight']
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.func=airborne_tuck_rate
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.params={}
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_wheel_below_base.weight=RECIPE['wheel_below_base_weight']
    for name,weight in [('path_progress',1.),('requested_forward',RECIPE['requested_forward_rate_weight'])]:
        setattr(cfg.rewards,'h1_step270_'+name,RewardTermCfg(func=measured_rate,weight=weight,params={'name':name}))
    push=cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_push_vz
    push.params=dict(original_func=push.func,original_params=dict(push.params));push.func=forward_takeoff_rate
    cfg._h1_step270_path_reward_recipe=dict(RECIPE)
    return cfg

"""Own H1 public-request observer and reward environment; inherited physical loop unchanged."""
import torch
from chassis_pd_training_env import ChassisPDMod4Env
from h1_takeoff_progress_phase_v2 import H1TakeoffProgressPhaseV2 as H1PublicRequestPhase
from h1_authored_full_collider_plane_reference_v1 import extract,evaluate
def tensor(v):

    minimum=torch.empty(len(recipe),device=device)
    for first in range(0,len(recipe),128):
        last=min(first+128,len(recipe));v=quat[first:last,None,:3];p=points[None].expand(last-first,-1,-1)
        rot=p+2*torch.cross(v.expand_as(p),torch.cross(v.expand_as(p),p,dim=-1)+quat[first:last,None,3:4]*p,dim=-1)
        minimum[first:last]=rot[:,:,2].amin(-1)
    return quat,minimum,(1+torch.cos(angle))/2


def validate_V8_trace_reward_publication_only(path):
    from h1_lifetime_goal_counter_v1 import canonical_V8_trace_tree
    tree=canonical_V8_trace_tree(path)
    cls=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='H1ControlPrefixTrace')
    install=next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='install')
    step=next(n for n in install.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='step')
    pub=ast.parse('self.env._h1_sampled_actions_for_reward=raw').body[0]
    clear=ast.parse('self.env._h1_sampled_actions_for_reward=None').body[0]
    matches=[n for n in step.body if ast.dump(n)==ast.dump(pub)]
    assert len(matches)==1
    step.body.remove(matches[0])
    enabled=ast.parse('self.env._h1_sampled_excess_training_active=True').body[0]
    flags=[n for n in step.body if ast.dump(n)==ast.dump(enabled)];assert len(flags)==1;step.body.remove(flags[0])
    tries=[n for n in step.body if isinstance(n,ast.Try)];assert len(tries)==1
    disabled=ast.parse('self.env._h1_sampled_excess_training_active=False').body[0]
    assert len(tries[0].finalbody)==2 and ast.dump(tries[0].finalbody[0])==ast.dump(clear) and ast.dump(tries[0].finalbody[1])==ast.dump(disabled)
    tries[0].finalbody=[]
    original=base64.b64decode('')
    assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()=='a24011df3a43e580fa15037791c30e9f8dacdaf4d0f6b9dd62b00276798414bd'
    assert ast.dump(tree)==ast.dump(ast.parse(original.decode('utf8')))
    return dict(passed=True,only_existing_raw_clone_training_scope_and_finally_clear=True,original_step_forwarding_persist_retention_fullSHA_and_errors_AST_exact=True)

def check(B,key):
    """Return JSON-serializable receipt or raise on any source/data mismatch."""
    import numpy as np
    B=Path(B).resolve();key='recovery' if key=='e3' else key
    if key not in EXPECTED:raise ValueError('Expected h1 or recovery payload root')
    actual={rel:H(B/rel) for rel in EXPECTED[key]}
    if actual!=EXPECTED[key]:raise RuntimeError('Installed acceleration file SHA mismatch')
    result=dict(passed=False,status='checking_CPU_only',key=key,base=str(B),
                expected_base_SHA=BASE[key],candidate_SHA=actual,
                exact_source_allowlist=list(EXPECTED[key]),no_GPU_API_SDK_scene_policy_physics_or_canonical=True,
                actual_live_SDK_joint_order_or_CUDA_outputs_not_claimed=True)
    if key=='h1':
        result['V8_reward_publication_AST']=validate_V8_trace_reward_publication_only(B/'h1_production_control_prefix_trace_v1.py')
        from h1_lifetime_goal_counter_v1 import installed_counter_CPU_checks,installed_landing_journal_CPU_checks
        result['lifetime_goal_diagnostic_CPU']=installed_counter_CPU_checks(B)
        result['landing_event_journal_CPU']=installed_landing_journal_CPU_checks(B)
        helper=_module('owned_acceleration_npz_CPU_check',B/'sampling_trace_npz_lossless_v1.py')
        rng=np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(20261025))
        arrays=dict(policy35=rng.standard_normal((24,3,35),dtype=np.float32),
                    q30=rng.standard_normal((24,3,30),dtype=np.float32),
                    history5ms=rng.standard_normal((24,3,3,2,3),dtype=np.float32),
                    counts=np.arange(72,dtype=np.int64).reshape(24,3),
                    flags=np.zeros((24,3),dtype=np.bool_),
                    special=np.array([0,0x80000000,0x7fc00001,0xffc00002,0x7f800000,0xff800000],dtype=np.uint32).view(np.float32))
        buf=io.BytesIO();helper.write_arrays_npz(buf,arrays,compresslevel=1);buf.seek(0)
        with np.load(buf,allow_pickle=False) as loaded:
            assert loaded.files==list(arrays)
            assert all(loaded[k].dtype==v.dtype and loaded[k].shape==v.shape and loaded[k].tobytes()==v.tobytes() for k,v in arrays.items())
        rows=[{k:v[i] for k,v in arrays.items() if k!='special'} for i in range(24)]
        buf=io.BytesIO();helper.write_trace_rows_npz(buf,rows,compresslevel=1);buf.seek(0)
        with np.load(buf,allow_pickle=False) as loaded:
            assert all(loaded[k].dtype==v.dtype and loaded[k].shape==v.shape and loaded[k].tobytes()==v.tobytes() for k,v in arrays.items() if k!='special')
        assert helper.sha256_file(B/'sampling_trace_npz_lossless_v1.py')==actual['sampling_trace_npz_lossless_v1.py']
        result.update(passed=True,status='CPU_exact_installed_sources_and_lossless_fixture_passed',
                      NPZ_array_bytes_dtype_shape_exact=True,full_SHA_preserved=True,
                      actual_persist_retention_evidence='V1 actual persist/retention/fault CPU report retained in preparation archive; exact canonical trace AST retains original persist/retention plus reviewed raw-reward publication only')
        return result
    import torch
    runtime=B/'job0/runtime/isaac/mod4';permpath=runtime/'e1_rough_reset_tensor.py'
    if H(permpath)!=PERMUTATION_SHA:raise RuntimeError('Original joint_permutation source changed')
    _module('e1_rough_reset_tensor',permpath)
    cachemod=_module('owned_acceleration_e3_cache_CPU_check',runtime/'e3_reset_bank_cache_v1.py')
    bankpath=runtime/'MOD4_RESET_COLLISION_BANK.npz'
    st=bankpath.stat()
    if st.st_size!=BANK_BYTES:raise RuntimeError('New-payload bank size mismatch')
    raw=bankpath.read_bytes()  # Exactly one byte read of the NEW payload bank.
    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=BANK_SHA:raise RuntimeError('New-payload bank SHA mismatch')
    after=bankpath.stat()
    if (st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns,st.st_ino,st.st_ctime_ns)!=(after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns,after.st_ino,after.st_ctime_ns):
        raise RuntimeError('Bank changed during new-payload CPU validation')
    with np.load(io.BytesIO(raw),allow_pickle=False) as bank:
        names=list(bank['joint_names']);pick=int(np.argmin(abs(bank['root_height']-.25)))
        points=torch.as_tensor(bank['points_root'][pick],device='cpu',dtype=torch.float32)
        bank_q=bank['q'][pick].copy()
    before_rng=torch.random.get_rng_state().clone();cpu_threads=torch.get_num_threads();torch.set_num_threads(1)
    old_read=Path.read_bytes;memory_read_requests=0
    def cached_read(path):
        nonlocal memory_read_requests
        if path.resolve()==bankpath.resolve():memory_read_requests+=1;return raw
        return old_read(path)
    cases=[]
    try:
        with mock.patch.object(Path,'read_bytes',cached_read):
            for robot_names in (names,list(reversed(names))):
                recipe=torch.arange(520,device='cpu',dtype=torch.long)%13
                expected_geometry=_original_geometry(torch,points,recipe)
                perm=[names.index(x) for x in robot_names]
                expected_q=torch.as_tensor(bank_q[perm],device='cpu',dtype=torch.float32)[None].repeat(len(recipe),1)
                for inference_ctor in (False,True):
                    with torch.inference_mode(inference_ctor):cache=cachemod.E3ResetBankCache(bankpath,robot_names,'cpu')
                    with torch.inference_mode():values=cache.selected_geometry(recipe,robot_names)
                    assert all(a.shape==b.shape and a.dtype==b.dtype and torch.equal(a,b) for a,b in zip(values,(expected_q,*expected_geometry)))
                    cache.validate(robot_names)
                    assert cache.pick==pick and cache.source_sha==BANK_SHA
                    assert all(value._version>=0 for value in (cache._q,cache._quat,cache._minimum,cache._initial))
                    cases.append(dict(joint_order='bank' if robot_names==names else 'reverse',inference_constructor=inference_ctor,
                                      inference_selection=True,selected=520,original_per_selected_geometry_and_q_exact=True))
        assert torch.equal(before_rng,torch.random.get_rng_state())
    finally:torch.set_num_threads(cpu_threads)
    result.update(passed=True,status='CPU_exact_installed_sources_and_fresh_bank_geometry_context_passed',
                  bank_SHA=BANK_SHA,bank_bytes=BANK_BYTES,fresh_bank_physical_read_count=1,
                  constructor_memory_read_requests=memory_read_requests,points_per_pose=len(points),selected_bank_pose=pick,
                  normal_and_inference_cases=cases,global_CPU_torch_RNG_unchanged=True,
                  original_margin_m=.0001,selected_reset_SDK_calls_unchanged_by_exact_source_AST=True,
                  real_CUDA_or_live_SDK_validation_remaining=True)
    return result
